components.description: One semester of parental leave at full pay for a primary or coequal care-giving faculty parent (birth, partner of a birth mother, adoption, foster); full relief from teaching, with research and advising normally continuing; half pay each if both parents (both UNM faculty) take leave.
components.mechanism_note: A dedicated paid parental leave granted by the Faculty Handbook; relief is partial (teaching relieved, research and advising continue), so its relief category comes from its relief fields (R4c).
components.faculty_group_note: All regular contract faculty at .50 FTE or higher (Faculty Handbook C215 2.1); HSC defines its own relief (2.3)
components.eligible_parent_wording: Mothers giving birth, spouses or domestic partners of mothers giving birth, parents adopting, and parents accepting a long-term foster placement or fostering toward adoption
components.caregiver_condition_wording: a primary or coequal care-giving faculty parent as defined within this policy
components.service_requirement: at least one semester of employment at UNM; .50 FTE or higher
components.dual_employee_rule: each is eligible; if both parents take leave, each reimbursed at one-half of usual salary; same-department couples discuss concurrent or consecutive (preferable) leave with the chair
components.entitlement_note: V2: the policy provides the leave and states that eligible faculty 'are eligible'; the dean or chair and the faculty member develop a plan (arrangements), with appeal on the plan to the EVP. The policy calls it 'a revocable benefit under certain circumstances' (misuse: outside paid work, return obligation), which does not make the grant discretionary.
components.duration_note: One semester; the policy states no qualifier. Additional leave in extraordinary circumstances is a separate component (c2).
components.relief_note: Full relief from 'teaching duties and similar responsibilities'; research and advising stated to continue normally (not during medically required leave). Service and clinical duties are not named, coded continues under R4b. Each dean may set relief guidelines; HSC defines relief for HSC faculty.
components.time_window: should normally begin within one calendar year after the birth or placement (exceptions case by case under 3.1)
components.return_obligation: return to work at UNM for a minimum of time equal to leave time taken
components.notice: discuss with the dean or chair well in advance of the leave

sequence.note: C215 1.3: parental leave is granted in addition to any medically required leave of the birth mother; it follows that leave.

components.description: FMLA: up to 12 weeks of unpaid job-protected leave in a rolling 12-month period for birth, adoption or foster placement, the employee's own serious health condition (pregnancy included) or care of an ill family member; placed by C215 2.4 after the paid parental leave.

components.dual_employee_rule: combined total of twelve (12) weeks for birth or placement when both parents are University employees (not for a serious health condition)
components.duration_note: Up to 12 weeks in a rolling 12-month period (statute: 12 workweeks, 29 U.S.C. 2612(a)(1)). Leave beyond 12 weeks may be granted under UAP 3420 (not saved), without guaranteed return to the same position. Intermittent or reduced-schedule leave for a birth needs the supervisor's agreement.
components.medical_certification_note: required for leave for medical reasons (own or family serious health condition), not for bonding
components.time_window: bonding leave must conclude within twelve (12) months of the birth or placement
components.notice: 30 days before the start of the leave when foreseeable

notes: Reference date 2018-03-12. All eight usable sources are Wayback captures between 2018-02-13 and 2018-04-03, within the 2017-18 academic year; C215 (approved 2010/2011) is the governing faculty parental-leave policy on the reference date.

Navigation-only content: the opening parts of 2018_06 and 2018_07 are site menus; 2018_05 (B4 Faculty Reviews) holds no leave or clock provision; 2018_03 (C245) recognises 'occasional brief absence because of illness, accident, or family crisis' with the faculty member arranging coverage: no leave is granted, no length or pay stated, so not a component.

RPM 5.4 lists 'maternity leave' among authorized faculty leaves and refers to 'Faculty Handbook [1990 ed.], pages the rule for a governing document cited but not saved to C-7' for the text; no maternity-leave text is saved and the 2018 Faculty Handbook leave section saved here contains C215 Parental Leave (cross_reference_not_saved: Faculty Handbook [1990 ed.] pages the rule for a governing document cited but not saved to C-7). No component is created from the list.

Cross-references not saved: UAP 3420 Leave Without Pay; UAP 3430 Catastrophic Leave Program; UAP 3630 Workers' Compensation; UAP 3110 Reasonable Accommodation; UAP 3225 Separation of Employment; UAP 3600 Eligibility for Benefit Plans; Faculty Handbook C200 Sabbatical, C205 Annual Leave, C220 Holidays, C225 Professional Leave, C230 Military Leave, C235 Service Abroad, C240 Political Activity; Faculty Handbook [1990 ed.] the rule for a governing document cited but not saved to C-7; FMLA forms (Section 13).

Birth-parent chain: extended sick leave c3 (discretionary, up to 6 months, its pay c4 within it) -> C215 parental leave c1 (1 semester, full pay, teaching relieved, research continues) -> FMLA c5 (12 weeks unpaid, placed after c1 by C215 2.4). In the guaranteed variant c3/c4 drop out and c1 is followed by c5.

Non-birth-parent chain: C215 parental leave c1 (1 semester, full pay) -> FMLA c5 (12 weeks unpaid). c2 (extraordinary-circumstances additional leave, no length) follows c1; c6 (own balances) runs with c5 and adds no weeks.

U8 path: a member with two years of service. C215 requires one semester of service; FMLA 12 months and 1,250 hours; C280 two years. C210's six-month extended sick leave needs six years of service; for less, 'reduced accordingly' with no stated reduction, so the six-month maximum is coded on c3/c4 and flagged as a rule gap.

C215 pays full pay when only one parent takes the leave; when both parents (both UNM faculty) take it each receives one-half of salary (dual_employee_rule on c1). Relief: full relief from teaching; research and advising normally continue (R4c, Just teaching); each dean may set relief guidelines; HSC defines relief for HSC faculty.
Calendar: semester system stated without length -> calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.
